English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #fake Chandrakanthan and Viyalendiran’s fight captured in an AI-generated video shared online False FactSeeker has identified a video circulating on social media that allegedly shows a confrontation between Tamil Makkal Liberation Tigers (TML) leader Sivanesathurai Chandrakanthan and former MP Sathasivam Viyalendiran. by Anonymous | March 18, 2025 https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1ETXL5Mf8s/ Upon careful analysis, it has been confirmed that the video was generated using artificial intelligence. The investigation revealed that the video was manipulated using AI to alter a photograph taken during the Eastern Tamil Alliance agreement signing ceremony in Batticaloa on March 15th. Therefore, FactSeeker confirms that the circulating video is AI-generated and urges the public to refrain from sharing or spreading such manipulated content. The objective and long-term goal of the FactSeeker is to provide the public with reliable and verified content in the attempt of debunking mis/disinformation. The unit, with the SLPI, is committed to contributing to improved media literacy in Sri Lanka.
